Subject: Linden Pantry charity stream — November 21

Last year, we raised $212, and a lot of people didn’t hear about the stream until the day of. So here’s the early heads-up: I’m streaming for the Linden Community Pantry on Saturday, November 21, from 10am to 10pm.

The pantry is serving around 340 families a week, and its shelves are especially low ahead of Thanksgiving. Donations go straight to the pantry—nothing is taken out—and through its wholesale partner, each $1 provides about 4 pounds of food. The goal is $600, and Rook is matching the first $100 donated, so those first donations go twice as far.

You can donate at lindenpantry.example/mrkz. No card? You can still help: canned and boxed food can be dropped in the blue bin by the pantry’s side door on Saturdays from 9am to 1pm. Sharing the stream or stopping by to hang out helps too. Even $3 makes a difference, but please don’t feel bad if you can’t give.

And yeah, I get that charity streams can look like begging with extra steps. I’m also making myself do ridiculous stuff on stream, so it’s not exactly a hardship: $100 unlocks a round of controller-upside-down gameplay; at $250, chat picks my hair dye color and I dye it on stream; at $400, chat picks the music for an hour (no skipping); and at $600, I’ll vlog a grocery pickup arranged by the pantry. Hair dye content for a good cause? Seems fair.

We’ll start with community game lobbies—anyone can join, and I’ll post the code—then chat will vote on the game every two hours. No repeat maps, Larry. Hope to see you there, whether you donate, play, or just hang out.
